blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms will persist over parts of the Visayas and Mindanao on Monday, October 5, due to the trough of Super Typhoon Choi-wan, which remains outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
